description.fr-FR: Premier volume de l’Année liturgique : la préface générale, l’histoire, le mystère et la pratique de l’Avent, les prières du matin et du soir, de la messe et des offices, puis le Propre du temps et le Propre des saints, jour après jour.
description.en-US: Volume 1 of the 15-volume Liturgical Year (L’Année liturgique) in the original French: Advent. One chapter per day or feast, with the liturgical texts in Latin and French as the edition prints them.
description.pt-BR: Volume 1 dos 15 volumes de «O Ano Litúrgico» (L’Année liturgique) em francês: o Advento. Um capítulo por dia ou festa, com os textos litúrgicos em latim e francês como a edição os imprime.

fr-FR.editor: Dom Prosper Guéranger, abbé de Solesmes (14th ed., Oudin)

sources.description: Dom Guéranger site (Societas pro canonizatione D. Guéranger), WordPress text of the 14th edition (1900). Split at each day or feast heading; verse kept as hard line breaks; footnotes renumbered per chapter.
sources.tierEvidence: Guéranger died in 1875; the text is the 19th-century edition transcribed.
